question: How many countries are there in the world.countries layer?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.countries

question: How many countries are in Africa?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.countries WHERE continent = 'Africa'

question: What is the estimated population (pop_est) of Turkey?
gold_sql: SELECT pop_est FROM world.countries WHERE name = 'Turkey'

question: Which country in South America has the largest population?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM world.countries WHERE continent = 'South America' ORDER BY pop_est DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many populated places are national capitals (is_capital = true)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.cities WHERE is_capital

question: How many populated places have a pop_max above 5 million?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.cities WHERE pop_max > 5000000

question: Which are the three most populous cities in Japan (by pop_max)? Give their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM world.cities WHERE country = 'Japan' ORDER BY pop_max DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many pharmacies (kind = 'pharmacy') are there in the Ankara POI data?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'pharmacy'

question: How many restaurants in the Ankara POI data have cuisine 'kebab'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'restaurant' AND cuisine = 'kebab'

question: How many distinct kinds of POI exist in the 'amenity' category of the Ankara POI data?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT kind) FROM ankara.pois WHERE category = 'amenity'

question: How many road segments in the Ankara roads layer are of highway type 'primary'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.roads WHERE highway = 'primary'

question: How many parks in the Ankara parks layer have a name (name is not null) and leisure = 'park'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.parks WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND leisure = 'park'

question: How many admin-1 regions does the United States of America have in the world.provinces layer?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.provinces WHERE country = 'United States of America'

question: How many pharmacies are within 500 metres of Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'pharmacy' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography, 500)

question: How many cafes are within 300 metres of Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography, 300)

question: How many restaurants are within 1 kilometre of Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography, 1000)

question: How many banks are within 200 metres of Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'bank' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography, 200)

question: What is the distance in metres from Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541) to the nearest hospital (kind = 'hospital')? Round to the nearest 10 m.
gold_sql: SELECT round(min(ST_Distance(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography))::numeric, -1) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'hospital'

question: Which subway station (kind = 'subway_station') is nearest to Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'subway_station' ORDER BY ST_Distance(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography) LIMIT 1

question: Which are the three pharmacies nearest to Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)? Give their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'pharmacy' ORDER BY ST_Distance(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography) LIMIT 3) t

question: How many schools (kind = 'school') are within 1500 metres of the point lat 39.925, lon 32.83?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'school' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.83, 39.925), 4326)::geography, 1500)

question: What is the geodesic distance in kilometres between the populated places Ankara and Istanbul (country Turkey)? Round to the nearest km.
answer_hint: km; tool distances are in metres
gold_sql: SELECT round((ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, b.geom::geography) / 1000)::numeric) FROM world.cities a, world.cities b WHERE a.name = 'Ankara' AND a.country = 'Turkey' AND b.name = 'Istanbul' AND b.country = 'Turkey'

question: How many populated places other than Ankara itself, with pop_max above 1,000,000, lie within 500 km of Ankara (Turkey)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.cities c, (SELECT geom FROM world.cities WHERE name = 'Ankara' AND country = 'Turkey') a WHERE c.pop_max > 1000000 AND NOT (c.name = 'Ankara' AND c.country = 'Turkey') AND ST_DWithin(c.geom::geography, a.geom::geography, 500000)

question: How many POIs from the Ankara POI layer lie inside the park named 'Gençlik Parkı'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois p JOIN ankara.parks k ON ST_Within(p.geom, k.geom) WHERE k.name = 'Gençlik Parkı'

question: Which country polygon in world.countries contains the point lat 48.85, lon 2.35?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM world.countries WHERE ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(2.35, 48.85), 4326))

question: In which neighbourhood (ankara.neighbourhoods) is Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM ankara.neighbourhoods WHERE ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326))

question: How many countries does the river named 'Danube' intersect in world.rivers / world.countries?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.name) FROM world.countries c JOIN world.rivers r ON ST_Intersects(c.geom, r.geom) WHERE r.name = 'Danube'

question: How many road segments of the Ankara roads layer intersect the neighbourhood 'Kocatepe Mahallesi'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.roads r JOIN ankara.neighbourhoods n ON ST_Intersects(r.geom, n.geom) WHERE n.name = 'Kocatepe Mahallesi'

question: How many lakes of the world.lakes layer intersect the country Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.lakes l JOIN world.countries c ON ST_Intersects(l.geom, c.geom) WHERE c.name = 'Canada'

question: How many populated places of world.cities lie inside the bounding box lon 5..15, lat 45..55?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.cities WHERE geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(5, 45, 15, 55, 4326)

question: How many neighbourhoods of ankara.neighbourhoods touch the neighbourhood 'Kocatepe Mahallesi' (share a boundary, excluding itself)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.neighbourhoods a, ankara.neighbourhoods b WHERE b.name = 'Kocatepe Mahallesi' AND a.osm_id <> b.osm_id AND ST_Touches(a.geom, b.geom)

question: What is the total population (sum of pop_est) of all countries in Europe?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(pop_est) FROM world.countries WHERE continent = 'Europe'

question: How many countries are in Asia and Oceania combined?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM world.countries WHERE continent IN ('Asia', 'Oceania')

question: What is the average pop_max of populated places that are national capitals? Round to the nearest whole number.
gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(pop_max)) FROM world.cities WHERE is_capital

question: Which continent has the highest total GDP (sum of gdp_musd) in world.countries?
gold_sql: SELECT continent FROM world.countries GROUP BY continent ORDER BY sum(gdp_musd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total geodesic area in km2 of all parks in the Ankara parks layer? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT round((sum(ST_Area(geom::geography)) / 1e6)::numeric, 1) FROM ankara.parks

question: What is the total geodesic length in km of roads with highway = 'residential' in the Ankara roads layer? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT round((sum(ST_Length(geom::geography)) / 1000)::numeric, 1) FROM ankara.roads WHERE highway = 'residential'

question: Which highway type has the greatest total length in the Ankara roads layer?
gold_sql: SELECT highway FROM ankara.roads GROUP BY highway ORDER BY sum(ST_Length(geom::geography)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the geodesic area of Turkey in km2 according to the world.countries polygon? Round to the nearest 1000 km2.
gold_sql: SELECT round((ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1e6)::numeric, -3) FROM world.countries WHERE name = 'Turkey'

question: Which African country has the largest area (geodesic) in world.countries?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM world.countries WHERE continent = 'Africa' ORDER BY ST_Area(geom::geography) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct countries appear in the country column of world.cities?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT country) FROM world.cities

question: Which neighbourhood contains the most pharmacies (kind = 'pharmacy')?
gold_sql: SELECT n.name FROM ankara.neighbourhoods n LEFT JOIN ankara.pois p ON ST_Contains(n.geom, p.geom) AND p.kind = 'pharmacy' GROUP BY n.osm_id, n.name ORDER BY count(p.*) DESC, n.name LIMIT 1

question: How many neighbourhoods contain at least one cafe (kind = 'cafe')?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.neighbourhoods n WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ankara.pois p WHERE p.kind = 'cafe' AND ST_Contains(n.geom, p.geom))

question: How many pharmacies lie inside the neighbourhood 'Hacettepe Mahallesi'?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois p JOIN ankara.neighbourhoods n ON ST_Contains(n.geom, p.geom) WHERE p.kind = 'pharmacy' AND n.name = 'Hacettepe Mahallesi'

question: Using a spatial join between world.countries and world.cities, which country polygon contains the most populated places?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM world.countries c JOIN world.cities p ON ST_Contains(c.geom, p.geom) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY count(*) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

question: How many parks in the Ankara parks layer contain at least one cafe (kind = 'cafe')?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.parks k WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ankara.pois p WHERE p.kind = 'cafe' AND ST_Contains(k.geom, p.geom))

question: What is the total pop_max of the populated places inside Germany (spatial join of world.countries and world.cities)?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.pop_max) FROM world.cities p JOIN world.countries c ON ST_Contains(c.geom, p.geom) WHERE c.name = 'Germany'

question: What is the area in km2 of a 1 km radius buffer around Kizilay Square, Ankara (lat 39.9208, lon 32.8541)? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round((ST_Area(ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(32.8541, 39.9208), 4326)::geography, 1000)::geography) / 1e6)::numeric, 2)

question: How many banks (kind = 'bank') are within 250 metres of the park named 'Gençlik Parkı' (distance measured to the park polygon)?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ankara.pois p, ankara.parks k WHERE p.kind = 'bank' AND k.name = 'Gençlik Parkı' AND ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography, k.geom::geography, 250)

question: What is the area in km2 of the union of 200 m buffers around all hospitals (kind = 'hospital') in the Ankara POI data? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round((ST_Area(ST_Union(ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 200)::geometry)::geography) / 1e6)::numeric, 2) FROM ankara.pois WHERE kind = 'hospital'

question: What is the northernmost latitude among all POIs of the Ankara POI layer? Round to 3 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round(max(ST_Y(geom))::numeric, 3) FROM ankara.pois

question: What is the westernmost longitude of Turkey in world.countries? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT round(ST_XMin(geom)::numeric, 2) FROM world.countries WHERE name = 'Turkey'
